description: Verbatim customer quotes extracted by a search, filtered and paged. Free. Each quote carries a stable id, the source url, a dimension (emotional_painpoints, recurring_painpoints, desired_outcomes, failed_solutions, objections, customer_lingo), an engagement score and an emotional intensity (1 to 5). For ad copy, pull emotional_painpoints and customer_lingo sorted by intensity.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the quote text.

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

name: get_quotes
title: Get quotes
